description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement HUNTRESS' EYE (Null Maiden Vigil, WP-C46): in your Movement phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit; it makes a battle-shock roll at -1 (once per Movement phase — ruling). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2); setup privileges: P1 detachment Null Maiden Vigil, CP 0 for both, and Witchseeker Squad D stands in as the bearer (no fixture has an ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER such as a Knight-Centura; the enhancement is read from meta.enhancements exactly as for a mustered bearer). The Custodes player ends the Movement phase with the real button: the movement_phase_end window shows the free HUNTRESS' EYE card; a real click opens the target picker listing the visible Gretchin (~4" away); a real click picks it; the Gretchin make a battle-shock roll at -1 (dice + verdict in the Game Log).

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Null Maiden Vigil"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.units["U_WITCHSEEKERS_D"].meta["enhancements"] = ["Huntress' Eye"]
return true

steps.comment: the Gretchin's battle-shock roll at -1 is logged
